{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for presence of the three channels as per the question
channels = data['channel'].unique()
print(f"Channels in data: {channels}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check revenue column dtype and sample values
print(f"Revenue dtype: {data['revenue'].dtype}")
print(f"Sample revenue values: {data['revenue'].head(5).values}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of customer_age == -1: {(data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")"}
